name: home-concept-instrument
refs: REFERENCE 1, the v4 Loika (creature look, fur, eyes, crest, moss floor): match the creature exactly.
REFERENCE 2, the glass: clear glass, matte dark edge, no reflections (the DO picture only).
REFERENCE 3, FINISH ONLY: the matte surface and the soft broad highlights. Ignore its blue display, its orange corners, its hands, its lettering and its composition entirely.
prompt:
Painted key frame, landscape, viewed straight on, flat to camera. The whole frame is the face of one precision instrument, an always-on display at home. Mood: a fine watch dial at night, a Braun radio, a planetarium projector in a dark room. Adult, restrained, warm, quietly wondrous.

GROUND: the entire face is deep matte slate, a soft charcoal with a faint powder-coat grain. No bezels, no buttons, no screws, no device housing drawn: it is the screen itself.

THE LATTICE (fills the whole face, behind everything): a slow woven lattice of extremely fine lines, like a loom's warp threads or a harp's strings, running in long gentle arcs from the lower centre outward and up to the upper corners and right edge. It reads as a living genome sculpture etched into dark smoked glass. Most lines are UNLIT: barely visible hairline engravings in the glass, a slightly lighter slate, catching only the faintest top-left light. About one line in six is LIT: a thin filament of warm, low light (honey, pale gold, a few in soft rose and pale aqua) glowing from inside the glass like edge-lit engraving, soft and dim, never neon, no bloom halos, no glow outlines. Where lit lines cross there are small nodes. Along the lit filaments sit 7 to 9 tiny painted vignettes, each a small upright rectangular glass slide with softly rounded corners (like lantern slides or microscope slides, NOT circles, NOT badges), about 40x52 px at 1024x600 scale, each holding a miniature painterly close-up of one discovered look: a crest of leaves, a cream belly, pale flank spots, a dark saddle band, a plum coat swatch, a rust coat swatch, a slate-blue coat swatch, an amber eye. Further along, unlit lines carry empty slides of plain clear etched glass with nothing in them: the undiscovered. The upper part of the lattice reads faintly as branching, like a family tree drawn by threads: lines from each creature in the window rise, merge in pairs into parent nodes, and continue up.

THE WINDOW (one, the subject): a wide horizontal aperture cut into the lattice, about 60% of the frame width and 55% of its height, its lower edge about 12% above the bottom, slightly left of centre. Rectangle with softly rounded corners, edge a thin dark matte rubber lip, clear glass with no reflections or gloss streaks. Through it: the living vivarium, a warm sunlit mossy terrarium floor, smooth stones, tiny ferns, soft green depth of field, warm daylight from the top left. Three Loikas live inside (match reference 1 exactly: chunky small quadruped, cream belly, big round amber eyes with catchlights, two-leaf sprout crest, softly sculpted fur): one dark charcoal with pale patches, one slate-blue with pale spots, one rust with a darker saddle. At rest, one looking out. The life is the most saturated, detailed and lit thing on the screen. The lit filaments seem to continue out of the top edge of the window, as if each creature's own threads rise from it into the lattice.

STATUS (small, quiet, one line): along the very bottom edge, beneath the window, a single fine engraved horizontal scale line running most of the width, like the tuning scale of a Braun radio or a watch's minute track, with small tick marks. On it, five tiny stations in loop order left to right, each a minute engraved lowercase label in a thin clean sans serif and a single very small rectangular indicator lamp: "companion", "bay", "pods", "incubator", "vivarium". Lamps are off (dark) except "bay" glowing soft amber and "incubator" a thin warm white. The rail is about 4% of the frame height. No icons, no pictures in the status.

LIGHT: the only warm daylight is inside the window. The face is dark; the lit filaments are the only other light, low and warm. Calm, still, deep.

Painted, crafted, soft-edged digital painting with fine detail, high craft.

AVOID: neon, sci-fi HUD, holograms, glowing outlines, bloom, chrome, gloss or reflections on glass, circles, round medallions or badges, cute crates, jars, toy parts, sticker art, cartoon simplification, nursery colours, any readable text other than the five status words, devices or hands or housings drawn around the screen, DNA double-helix cliché, starfield.
